name: codex-session-control-plane
description: Orchestrate user-visible Codex tasks with native thread tools, durable state, controller decisions, and optional Coding Agents workers.
keywords: スレッドオーケストレーション

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate visible Codex tasks with durable control state
interface.longDescription: Create, observe, continue, fork, hand off, organize, and review user-visible Codex tasks through the native Codex task-tool family. Keep project resolution, thread addresses, operation intents, results, controller decisions, and optional Coding Agents worker boundaries in an atomic local ledger.
defaultPrompt: Create a dry-run thread-orchestration plan for this project.
Use 上位管制 to coordinate visible Codex tasks and retain their task IDs.
Run one Coding Agents workflow inside each isolated visible worker task.
